notes: No imagery lines accepted. Mound I's Harappan identification is checked in Mackay pp.59-60. Mound II uses the explicitly Harappa II plate, rather than the mixed general upper-level plan. Magnetic arrows dated 2 November 1935 are corrected with IGRF-14 for year1935. Mound II has distinct western and eastern block systems; all fitted lines and raw bearings are retained.
error_scope: Tool sigma preserved. Unspecified plan arrows leave true north unresolved. Shared north-arrow error, survey and paper distortion are outside an independence interpretation of the system SE.
